decisions.reason: Because the vinyl test series fits the firm's collector-focused physical-media niche and the growing market gives some slack, management would likely keep it for now, though its explicitly experimental nature makes it more vulnerable if it falls short of aspirations.

Because the German new wave compilation series is very close to the firm's core curated catalog offer and there is no sign of firm-level distress in a growing industry, management is likely to view it as satisfactory enough to retain unless results clearly miss aspirations.
